description: This is a Java interface defining the contract for shopping cart-related operations in an e-commerce system, including cart retrieval, creation, updating, merging, and shipping-related functionalities.

methods.name: getShoppingCart
methods.description: Retrieves the shopping cart associated with a specific customer.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves or updates the provided shopping cart.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a shopping cart by its ID and store context.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a shopping cart by its code within a specific merchant store.

methods.name: getByCustomer
methods.description: Retrieves the shopping cart associated with a specific customer.

methods.name: createShippingProduct
methods.description: Creates a list of ShippingProduct instances based on the shopping cart items.

methods.name: isFreeShoppingCart
methods.description: Checks if the shopping cart is free of charges, either by cart or items.

methods.name: populateShoppingCartItem
methods.description: Creates a ShoppingCartItem from a Product, including attributes if any.

methods.name: deleteCart
methods.description: Deletes a given shopping cart from the system.

methods.name: removeShoppingCart
methods.description: Removes the shopping cart, potentially from session or cache.

methods.name: mergeShoppingCarts
methods.description: Merges a user's shopping cart with a session cart for a given merchant store.

methods.name: requiresShipping
methods.description: Determines if the shopping cart requires shipping.
